text: When did you last look above your air fryer basket?
Grease splatters onto the heating coil and burns, over and over.
Smoke, burnt taste, even a fire risk.
Unplug it, let it cool, and flip it onto a towel.
Scrub the coil gently with a soft brush and soapy water. Then dry it.
Send this to an air fryer lover. Subscribe for more!
